resources.string: This service is required to automatically fill the PIN and confirmation step for USSD transactions. It only works while you are sending money and does not store your PIN.
Phone permission is required to dial USSD
Please enable the Accessibility Service for this app in Settings

1. Enter your mobile money PIN below
2. Enable Accessibility Service (button below)
3. Grant Phone permission
4. Tap Send Money

The app will dial the code, inject your PIN, then automatically reply with 1 on confirmation.
